I tried to set

export SPARK_CONNECT_MODE=classic

without success. My Python version is 3.10.12.

Why does the error occur?
answer:
I solved it creating a conda env and using the lower pyspark version along with a lower Java version, it didn't work with Java 23 either (getSubject deprecation).

conda create -n pyspark  
conda activate pyspark
conda install pyspark
sdk use java 11

and then it works after I run

(pyspark) $ pyspark
